fullContent:
Sampoorna Kanchana Rasa – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference – Ayurveda Yoga Ratnakara 
 Introduction 
 Sampoorna Kanchana Rasa is an ayurvedic formulation. This is formulated from the mixture of effective minerals. These minerals are known to contain anti-inflammatory, digestive, immunomodulator, energy booster, hematogenic, fat burner properties and many more. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Loha Bhasma – iron calx (calcinated iron) 
 Abhraka Bhasma – mica calx (calcinated) 
 Parada – mercury calx 
 Swarna Bhasma – gold calx 
 Gandhaka – sulfur calx 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 First of all kajjali is prepared. Then all ingredients are mixed to it and pills are made. 
 Dosage 
 1 pill two times a day, with chandanasava or warm water. 
 Indications 
 
 Pooyameha(Gonorrhoea) 
 Phiranga(syphilis) 
 
 Contraindications 
 Take the medicine under doctor’s prescription 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
